powerGrid.note: Marvel filed Bucky under his Captain America name; the archived Winter_Soldier page points to this page and shows the same ratings.

powerOrigins.detail: A cybernetic arm gives him superhuman strength, sensors, electric blasts, an EMP and resistance to blades and gunfire.

sources.label: Marvel Fandom wiki: James Buchanan Barnes (Earth-616)
Marvel Fandom wiki: Winter Soldier's Bionic Arm

powerOrigins.detail: Nick Fury's perfected Infinity Formula saved his life and raised him to peak human condition, with faster healing and halted ageing.

sources.label: Marvel Fandom wiki: James Buchanan Barnes (Earth-616)

powerOrigins.detail: Trained by wartime combat instructors and later by the Soviets as an assassin, giving him elite fighting, marksmanship and spycraft.

sources.label: Marvel Fandom wiki: James Buchanan Barnes (Earth-616)

abilities.name: Bionic arm
abilities.detail: Strikes beyond human limits, maps his surroundings, fires electrical bolts and an EMP, and shrugs off knives and bullets.

sources.label: Marvel Fandom wiki: James Buchanan Barnes (Earth-616)

abilities.name: Peak human conditioning
abilities.detail: The Infinity Formula gives him peak strength, speed, agility and stamina, plus fast healing and no ageing.

sources.label: Marvel Fandom wiki: James Buchanan Barnes (Earth-616)

abilities.name: Master martial artist
abilities.detail: A formidable armed and unarmed fighter who has beaten Crossbones, Wolverine and Black Widow.

sources.label: Marvel Fandom wiki: James Buchanan Barnes (Earth-616)

abilities.name: Master marksman
abilities.detail: An expert sniper and knife thrower; as a teenager he was the best sniper in his division.

sources.label: Marvel Fandom wiki: James Buchanan Barnes (Earth-616)

abilities.name: Shield fighting
abilities.detail: As Captain America he throws the shield to hit several targets in one throw and make it ricochet back.

sources.label: Marvel Fandom wiki: James Buchanan Barnes (Earth-616)

abilities.name: Spycraft and stealth
abilities.detail: Skilled in espionage, stealth, demolitions and survival, and can move from place to place undetected.

sources.label: Marvel Fandom wiki: James Buchanan Barnes (Earth-616)

abilities.name: Languages
abilities.detail: Fluent in English, Russian, German, Japanese and Chinese, with some French.

sources.label: Marvel Fandom wiki: James Buchanan Barnes (Earth-616)

feats.text: Freed from his conditioning, he seized the reality-warping Cosmic Cube and shattered it with his bionic arm.

sources.label: Marvel Fandom wiki: Captain America Vol 5 14
Marvel Fandom wiki: James Buchanan Barnes (Earth-616)

feats.text: Ambushed the S.H.I.E.L.D. car moving Captain America's shield, beat Black Widow in a fight and escaped with the shield.

sources.label: Marvel Fandom wiki: Captain America Vol 5 27
Marvel Fandom wiki: James Buchanan Barnes (Earth-616)

feats.text: Took up the role of Captain America, using his arm's sensors to throw the shield accurately and make it ricochet back.

sources.label: Marvel Fandom wiki: Captain America Vol 5 34
Marvel Fandom wiki: James Buchanan Barnes (Earth-616)

feats.text: Flipped Nick Fury's SUV with a disc grenade, then caught Captain America's thrown shield with his metal arm and hurled it back.

Marvel Cinematic Universe Wiki: Winter Soldier (Bucky Barnes)

feats.text: Overpowered Steve Rogers, Sam Wilson, Sharon Carter and Natasha Romanoff and withstood Iron Man gauntlet blasts while escaping the JCTC.

Marvel Cinematic Universe Wiki: Winter Soldier (Bucky Barnes)

feats.text: Alone on a motorcycle, he wrecked an O.X.E. convoy and flipped the limousine carrying the Thunderbolts with a disc grenade.
